title: Web Summit: Evento tecnologico com recorde de 71386 participantes (AICEP Portugal Global, 12 November 2025)
what_it_says: AICEP reports (in Portuguese, from the organisers' site, via Lusa) a record 71,386 participants from 157 countries, 1,857 investors and 2,725 startups at Web Summit 2025.
